title: Kimi K3 Biology Capabilities Assessment (2026-08-07)
abstract: Kimi K3 Biology Capabilities Assessment (2026-08-07). Sentences naming BioTIER from the system-card corpus.
text:
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] Kimi K3, the latest model from Moonshot AI, is the best-performing open-weights model on our knowledge benchmarks.
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] It is also among the most likely to answer biohazardous prompts, based on our BioTIER safeguard evaluation3.
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] Kimi K3’s biology safeguards trail behind closed-weights models BioTIER measures whether models refuse hazardous biological queries while permitting benign ones.
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] Kimi K3 refuses on only 26.9% of the questions in our BioTIER-refuse set.
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] Top-performing closed-weights models score over 90% on BioTIER-refuse.
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] Kimi K3 correctly permits 99.3% of questions on our BioTIER-permit set.
[securebio-kimi-k3-independent-eval] The BioTIER manuscript describes the full methodology.
